newsitem.title: USA: Chase CEO says would not have tightened.
newsitem.headline: Chase CEO says would not have tightened.

text.p: Chase Manhattan Corp chairman and chief executive officer Walter Shipley said Thursday he would have elected not to raise the federal funds rate as the Federal Reserve did earlier this week.

"I would have voted against it," Shipley said of the Fed's quarter point tightening on Tuesday. Shipley said he believes the economy has not felt the full effect of the stronger dollar yet. "The strength of the dollar I think will have a muting effect on the economy," he said in a speech to the Executives' Club of Chicago.
"I think... the economy is in pretty good shape, but not too exuberant," Shipley said.
